notes: Lidl BE campaign/search API — no cookies, no dynamic headers, no JS. Accept MUST stay */* (application/json → 406). Two URL shapes on the SAME /q/api/search endpoint, selected by endpoint_variants: (1) campaign — the a<ID> suffix of /c/.../a<ID> promo URLs → campaign=<id>&automatedCampaign=<id>; (2) section — the s<ID> suffix of /c/.../s<ID> category URLs → category.id=<id> (version 2.1.0). Both vars are optional and mutually exclusive per URL; campaign wins if both somehow match. A section id that is a NAV/service hub (Lidl s1000xxxx: assortiment, local-et-frais, dépliants, abonner) returns type:empty/0 items — correct, it has no catalogue; real product categories (s1006xxxx/s1007xxxx: aliments-boissons=122, cuisine-menage=957, bricolage-jardinage=1472) return the full catalogue. locale is rebuilt as {lang}_BE from the URL's nl-BE|fr-BE segment (API wants an underscore). fetchsize is server-capped at ~60/request, so 48 keeps offset += size == items served. A &q=<term> search may answer 301 with a JSON redirectURL — campaign/section queries answer 200 directly. canonicalPath/canonicalUrl are BOTH site-relative (no absolute product URL anywhere in the payload); cutoutimageV2 is always empty — never map it. ians[] are Lidl IANs (6-9 digits), NOT EANs — never map to gtin. weightText reads price.basePrice.text (500 g - 2,58 EUR/kg): the normaliser keeps its quantity part (500 g) — present on food items only; non-food items carry their weight, when they have one, in the description (labelled-weight gap filler). Validated live: campaign 2026-09-25 (114 products); section 2026-09-26 (category.id, aliments-boissons 122 products, paginated).
